name: Lake Hoppin'
description:
Enjoy a scenic bicycle ride on country roads, either side of Kanakapura Road, on the outskirts of Bangalore. You will hop across a dozen lakes and reservoirs that are set against a backdrop of rolling hills, on the fringes of the Bannerghatta National Park and the Ragihalli State Forest. In addition to stopping at and taking in views of these scenic water bodies, get a glimpse of the rural and semi-rural life as you pass through these villages. While cattle and their herders shuttle on dirt roads flanked by fields, orchards, and plantations, flocks of birds hang out on grasslands and backwaters. Given the undulating terrain in the region, you can expect challenges in the means of short and sweet ascents, and exhilarating descents.

description:
If you've ever been stranded on the road with a breakdown, you'll know the importance of bike maintenance. Even if you're new to cycling, this is essential know-how that will only make your journey into the world of bicycles even more fascinating. So come on over to our workshop and leave with some essential skills. You bring your own bike and we'll provide the tools. If you don't have a bike, just show up and we'll get you some hands-on on one of our bikes.

name: Ridge Trail
description:
Enjoy the freedom of being in the outdoors, away from the noise and traffic of the city. Take a ride on the Ridge Trail through the villages and farmlands off Chikka Tirupati road near Gunjur. As the name suggests, this easy route of 25km on mostly flat terrain, will take you over several lake bunds and ridges, offering scenic views of the countryside. This ride is ideal for beginners and those looking to get back in the saddle after a long break. Also, if you're new to our weekend rides, this ride is exactly what you need.

name: The Melagiri Challenge
description:
Join us on this cross-country ride in the Melagiri Hills, through the tranquil Aiyur forest region, in Tamil Nadu.
 Be prepared for a breathtaking day tour in some challenging terrain. Our carefully mapped-out biking routes here weave through hills, forests, farms and several water bodies. Bicycle touring can't be more fun than this!
The 70 km (L3) ride includes an intense climb up a hill and through a forest, but the sheer beauty of these landscapes will make you forget your tired legs. The rest of the route is mostly flat or downhill.
 You can choose the easier 40 km ride (L2) too. It is not mandatory for everyone to ride the entire distance that’s planned. You could hop into the support vehicle if you wish, and still enjoy the rest of the journey in this enchanting land.
